guide.title: How to use this app — step by step
guide.intro: Follow these steps in order. Steps 1 and 2 are done only once.
guide.s1Body: Tap “Sign in”, then “Create an account”. Use your email and choose a password. We email you a confirmation link: open it on this phone or on any other device. If you open it somewhere else, this phone signs you in by itself a few seconds later.
guide.s2Body: One person per family registers. Enter your NIC number, the NIC numbers of the family members who live with you, your district, Divisional Secretariat division and home address. You can also add a mobile number, an email address and a bank account. Each NIC number can belong to only one family.
guide.s3Body: On the Home page tap “Report Incident”. Take clear photos of the damage and confirm where it happened. This works without a network: the report is kept on your phone.
guide.s4Body: When you submit, you get a Proof of Claim. Once the report reaches the office it shows your reference number (HEC-…). Download it or take a screenshot: you need this number to follow your claim.
guide.s5Body: If there was no signal, the report is sent automatically the next time the phone is online. Open the app once when you have signal.
guide.s6Body: See all your claims under “My Claims”. Anyone can check a claim under “Status” with its reference number, without signing in. Turn on notifications, or give an email address, to be told when the status changes.
guide.s7Body: A wildlife officer reviews your report, the DWC administrator recommends an amount, and your Divisional Secretariat office decides the final amount and pays it into your bank account.
guide.s8Body: You can change your address, email, mobile number and password here on your profile. To change your district, division, family members or a saved bank account, visit your Divisional Secretariat office.
